press_references.value: PlayVS and Scouting America Announce Gaming Activation at the 2026 National Jamboree

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS formed a new partnership with Scouting America to run a PlayVS Arena gaming activation at the 2026 National Jamboree, providing structured esports tournaments, casual play, and digital citizenship programming for Scouts.

press_references.value: PLAYVS AND URBAN ONE ANNOUNCE OFFICIAL NAME AND LOGO OF HISTORIC LEAGUE: "POWER4+ HBCU ESPORTS LEAGUE"

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS and Urban One detailed their three-year partnership to operate the Power4+ HBCU Esports League within the PlayVS College League, combining PlayVS esports infrastructure with Urban One’s media reach to serve HBCU students and brand partners.

press_references.value: PlayVS Teams Up with Army National Guard to Show Students How Competitive Gaming Can Translate to Rewarding Careers

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS formed a strategic partnership with the Army National Guard to expand access to scholastic esports and expose students to Guard-related technology and leadership careers via platform access, events, and state championship sponsorships in WV, FL, and MA.

press_references.value: PlayVS and Urban One Launch Historic National HBCU Esports Community During Black History Month

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS and Urban One announced a three-year strategic partnership to build a national HBCU Esports Community within the PlayVS College League, providing fee-free competitive gaming infrastructure and media amplification for HBCU students.

press_references.value: National Football League and PlayVS Launch Second Season of the Madden NFL Youth Championship

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS and the NFL launched season two of the Madden NFL Youth Championship, expanding eligibility to Canada, introducing dual-path qualifiers, and adding a Super Bowl LX trip grand prize; finals are slated for January 20, 2026.

press_references.value: PlayVS Partners with The Pokémon Company International to Bring Pokémon UNITE to Scholastic Esports Leagues

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS announced a new partnership with The Pokémon Company International to bring Pokémon UNITE to its scholastic esports leagues for middle and high school students in the U.S. and Canada, marking the first time TPCi has collaborated with a third party for official scholastic leagues.

press_references.value: NASCAR & iRacing Renew Partnership with PlayVS as the Exclusive Partner for the 2025-26 eNASCAR College iRacing Series

partnership_announcements.description: PlayVS renewed its partnership with NASCAR and iRacing to serve as the exclusive platform partner for the 2025-26 eNASCAR College iRacing Series, expanding opportunities for collegiate esports participants.

about_short_description.short_description: PlayVS operates an eSports platform to organize high school and collegiate esports.

product.name: PlayVS Scholastic Esports Leagues
product.description: A competition platform for middle and high schools that organizes esports leagues, tournaments, matches, and community events across the United States and Canada.

product.name: Gaming Concepts
product.description: A grades 3–12 gaming and esports curriculum that teaches digital literacy, teamwork, strategy, communication, problem-solving, and responsible technology use through classroom-ready lessons.

product.name: PlayVS College League (PCL)
product.description: A collegiate esports league that provides universities and college teams with organized competition, league operations, and access to collegiate esports programming.

product.name: PlayVS Recruit
product.description: A collegiate esports recruiting service that connects high school esports talent with college programs through player data and recruitment opportunities.

product.name: PlayVS Coaching Solutions
product.description: Esports coaching and player-development services providing structured training, strategy development, drills, feedback, and performance reporting for school esports teams.

product.name: PlayVS Collective
product.description: A curated partner marketplace connecting schools with organizations that provide esports equipment, software, curriculum, coaching, facilities, and program support.
